title: Prompt Request Addition on Credit Builder Accounts Goodwill Credits
content:
The goodwill share applied to a Credit Builder late fee grows when the borrower asks soon after the fee was charged. The late fee is the one the goodwill credit applies to, the account's most recent late fee.

## Speed of the request

When the late fee was charged 10 or fewer calendar days before the request (the request date, which is today, less the fee's date), the prompt-request addition is added; when 11 to 30 days before, the later-request addition; when longer ago, nothing is added for promptness.

| Days from the fee's date to the request | Added to the goodwill share |
|---|---|
| 0 to 10 | prompt-request addition: 0.05 (5 percentage points) |
| 11 to 30 | later-request addition: 0.02 (2 percentage points) |
| 31 or more | nothing |

## Day counts (hypothetical dates)

A late fee dated 4 November: a request on 14 November (10 days) takes the prompt-request addition; on 15 November (11 days) the later-request addition; on 4 December (30 days) the later-request addition; on 5 December (31 days) nothing.
